decisions: D1 erasure minibatch (models a, b): 11 inputs per step drawn without replacement from target_train (32) with stream 2; n_latents = 11 (mirrors GEM's 11 prefix latents).

D2 model a/b sizes: a: P=300, d_out=8, d_in=8 (z 4 + embedding 4, 2 concept coords); b: d_in=8, hidden 16, d_out=8, r=4 (P=192), tanh gain 1 unless the cell sets it; c: c=4, n_img=4, n_txt=3, dm=8, r=2 (P=128).

D3 covered population: models a, b: retained inputs in a rank-q span (q=2, q*d_out=16=k) with zero concept coordinates; model c: retained conditioning tables in a rank-2 span. The rare subgroup (mass 0.005) keeps its generic form in both populations.

D4 drift units: every rho (and the gate statistic and tau^2) is normalised by Z = mean L^2 over target_test at theta0, a fixture constant fixed before training; model c's gate acts on velocities and is normalised by Z_v = mean velocity contrast ||b-a||^2 on target-sel velocity queries; tau0 for model c is calibrated on the velocity drift rho_vsel so tau is in the gate's own units.

D5 E_axial: q_i = clip(((b-v).e)/(L/2), 0, 1), i.e. axial progress measured from the target towards the anchor (0 at theta0, 1 at the bisector); the JSON wording '(v-a).e from the anchor' would give 1 at theta0.

D6 gate batches: one pool of T*R_max batches per unit (stream 4), consumed sequentially by gate TRIES (the j-th try of every arm uses the j-th batch); null steps consume none; base outputs cached (not charged).

D7 FE units: a/b: forward + 2*backward samples of the student on erasure and penalty inputs, 3 per sketch-row VJP sample (k*3*n1 per refresh), n1 for na_lora's single feature forward, n2 per gate try; teachers are not charged for a/b (protocol adamw_step_ab = 3*n_target_batch); model c additionally charges rollout and the two teacher forwards per latent (66 per iteration).
D8 rho floor: rho values are floored at 1e-12 before log ratios (na_lora can give exactly 0).

D9 calibration reference cells: G1 d=2 sketch generic; G2 kappa=1e2 phi=pi/8; G3 cos psi=0.1; G4 contrast 1e-2 (model a) and the model-b cell; G5 gain 1 generic (also used by G6, G7); G9 itself; G8 generic (also GD_D); GD_B uses G1's lr0. If native adamw never reaches E_sel 0.8 the calibration level falls back to 0.5 then 0.2; lr0 = argmin |t_cross - 23| (t_cross = inf if unreached; ties -> larger final E).

D10 G3: anisotropy 0 (column scaling would break the designed null/range split), kappa=1e2, phi=Haar; target inputs vary only in the concept coordinates whose Jacobian rows are cos(psi)*null + sin(psi)*range directions of the retained block; rich cell: generic T with P=40 < rank, so null(J_r) = {0}.

D11 G7 uses the G5 stream code so the non-probe controls are reused from G5 gain-1 covered exactly (same seeds, same fixture); G6 is computed from the G5 gain-1 and G1 d=2 sketch runs with rho_shift as Q1 metric.

D12 F1 is evaluated on the covered-population exact-J cells (d=2 OR d=3), ridge 1e-6, wd 0.01, lr0; generic cells and the ratio vs post_euclid are reported. P = E_test at step 10, or at the first step at which either arm's E_test reaches 0.95.
D13 F4 is triggered if GMR(vau / best of {penalty+gate, penalty_earlystop}) >= 1.0 in G5 OR in G8 (the value claim needs both); evaluated on COVERED primary cells, else on all primary cells.

D14 penalty_oracle: penalty with 28 lambda = lambda0*10^linspace(-3,3,28) x 4 lr in the G1 exact-J covered cells; 'flip' = G1's Q1 qualification differs when the oracle runs join the best-control pool.

D15 GD_B: linear student v = b + delta + J theta with M = J J^T = diag(1 axial, kappa transverse), offset |delta| = eps (eps/L cell) orthogonal to the axis, eps_n = 0 for both losses; r_end at the first step with zero loss (or the last step); SGD lr 1e-3*L up to 20000 steps (gradient-flow proxy, the falsification basis) and AdamW at G1's lr0 for 60 steps (reported).

D16 GD_D: rho_late = mean_{k>=11} ||v_student - v_base|| / mean_{k<=10} ||v_student - v_base|| on the target conditions along the trained prefix student's own rollouts; Spearman over (seed, arm) pairs.
D17 coverage drift along vau runs: computed in one vau run per unit (lr0, first tau value) with a 64-row held-out sketch; theta0 coverage uses the protocol's 256 rows.

D18 mechanism logs (beta_t, gamma_t, delta_t, imbalance, residual): every model-b run on full R_test; every model-c run on a fixed 256-query subset of the R_test velocity queries (cost); gamma_t = ratio of sums over layers and inputs.
D19 G9 measurement runs: lr 1e-3 and each arm's first secondary value, T=23; the safety grid uses G9's own lr0.
D20 failure: exception, NaN/Inf, or CPU time > 10x the frozen median per-run time of the model (dev: 120 s) marks the run failed; checkpoints after the failure have E = 0 and rho = +inf.
D21 matched selection ties/unreached: an arm whose configs never reach e is unreached (rho = inf); a cell's fallback level applies to all arms of that cell.
D22 vau_blocksplit on model a = one block (D/mean D), reported as identical to vau up to the ridge floor.
D23 dev phase statistics are computed with the seeds that were run (thresholds such as '>= 9 of 12' are scaled as fractions of the number of seeds); they are DEVELOPMENT ONLY and never a verdict.
label: DEVELOPMENT ONLY - not a verdict
